policy.A: Economic allocation among direct sale, battery and H2; no hard demand guarantee
policy.B: q_current=min(G,D); battery optional for remaining absorption; no forced imports or depletion
policy.existing_assets: Fixed given generation plus independent simulated farm per shared convention; unchanged sunk capital excluded

data.other_years: Earlier crisis-period contiguous segments as labelled stress tests;2026partial
data.daily_MW_interpretation: Assume daily average power where converting toMWh by24; original producer aggregation not independently established
data.state_gaps: Never silently join; use complete chronological segments
data.information: Daily Tier1 perfect foresight; fitted capacity fixed for later evaluation; operational oracle distinguished from causal policy

market.prices: Course wholesale daily price proxy deflated toGBP2020
market.status: Explicit classroom assumptions, not actual retail/PPA/compensation entitlements
market.fee_sensitivity: additive p-f_sell; no negative-price multiplicative haircut

battery.self_discharge_status: DEAtechnical scenario; separable from brief references
battery.FOM_status: Source formula/label2x conflict retained; higher noteN interpretation primary, not officialerratum
battery.lifetime_scope: Reference calendar/cycle conditions, no unconditional manufacturer guarantee
battery.daily_simplification: At most one direction and one usable-energy window per day plus power/state equations; conservative interday analysis
battery.state_boundary: No usable energy gift above minimumSOC; equal terminal usableSOC; commissioning energy accounted if modelled
battery.replacement: Do not charge same inverter/maintenance twice beyond DEAinclusiveFOM
battery.capacity_bound: Derive finite bound from finite source energy and nonnegative effective asset costs; record bound and ensure not binding economically

hydrogen.performance_scope: BOL whole-system; waterpurification andBOP energy included; throughput from energy identity
hydrogen.daily_on_rule: Full-day steady-mode simplification if using20–100% of24h; not exact intraday minimum-load equivalence

modern_CAPEX.source: IEA Global Hydrogen Review2025 executive summary; manufacture and install outside China in2024
modern_CAPEX.price_base_assumption: Treat the2024 observed USD costs as nominalUSD2024 for this reporting scenario; constant-dollar base not explicitly given in IEA summary
modern_CAPEX.denominator_assumption: Electrical capacity inferred from electrolyser context; summary does not label kWe or AC/DC
modern_CAPEX.FX_scope: Ratio of annual EUR-base reference rates; not independently computed annual average of dailyGBP/USD nor executable quotation
modern_CAPEX.cost_scope: Modern generic non-China installed reference, not ITM/UK site quotation; EPC+contingency already included
modern_CAPEX.replacement_rule: Do not multiply this installed cost by old BEIS60% stack share; use separately labelled absolute old-cost proxy or separate reserve scenario

hydrogen.replacement_status: Old absolute cost/schedule proxy, independently uncertain; never60% of modernIEAtotal

brief_H2_price_raw.price_basis: brief benchmark; do not silently callGBP2020 or a merchantcontract

supported_H2_reporting_case.scope: Supported strike-value reference only; not a commercial sale or eligibility guarantee

hydrogen.buyer_status: Analyst stress scenarios, no realofftaker identified
hydrogen.storage: No H2inventory baseline; same-day offtake within declared site boundary
hydrogen.downstream: Any compression/drying/delivery responsibilities must align with sale netback; do not assert free full-chain delivery
hydrogen.eligibility: No default subsidy/low-carbon eligibility for mixed pooled generation
hydrogen.capacity_bound: R3 finite bound only under noimports/noH2storage, monotonic positivecost, and independent20MWmodule assumptions

finance.discount_status: Analyst modelling choice, not verified riskfree/privateWACC
finance.capital_accounting: CRF by declared asset life; explicitreplacementPV annualised or reserve, notboth; representative annual operation assumption
finance.decommissioning_and_residual: Do not invent a guaranteedsalvage; any terminal treatment declared consistently with lifetimehorizon
